notes.title: New items have been added and updated.
notes.content:
We have added;
"Wine", an item that instantly restores physical strength,
"penguin suit" that makes it harder for penguins to find you while wearing it.

Adjusted the number of meats and the speed of the penguins.

In addition, only the main part of the game is compatible with the xbox controller.
Use the mouse and keyboard for menu/stage selection and configuration.

notes.title: Update is coming
notes.content:
[b]Update is coming[/b]
We are planning to implement the function.
By wearing an abandoned penguin,
 [b] "Stepen" [/b] that enhances the stealth of the player.
Player visibility is limited.

Also, only the game scene will be compatible with the controller.
